abstract: We establish structural, algebraic, and harmonic-analytic results across four Collatz interfaces, accompanied by an exact integer and rational verification suite (763,812 checks, zero floating-point operations). First, for the 3-adic inverse-routing branch maps Q_0, Q_1 and cross-branch conjugacies Phi_d on Z/3^m Z, we prove that the cyclic step maps and inverse step maps are bijections from Z/3^{m-1} Z onto their mod-3^m cosets, establish the higher-order inverse difference valuation law k + v_3(k!) bounding contiguous cyclic runs, prove an affine homothety conjugacy in multiplicative coordinates 4^s with simultaneous fixed point s_* = -1/2 and multi-step extinction of all proper mod-3 coset unions under the inter-layer lift-and-erosion operator, and determine the complete 2D Fourier spectrum via leading-3-adic-coefficient linearity on 3-coset orbits, yielding O(m^2 3^{m/2}) single-step interval discrepancy. Second, for every odd denominator q > 1 coprime to 6, we construct a closed-form (q+1)-state rational-pin weak YAH arctic automaton whose shifted boundary rules form an acyclic (3/2, 3/4)-forest solved by 1 + v_2(m+q), and give d = 12 and d = 15 relative top-termination certificates orienting all windows w >= 8 for the -19/11 loop. Third, we decompose two-center non-stationary 2-adic schedules into disjoint quadratic Tschakaloff valuation progressions, realizing exact Syracuse words modulo 2^{2N(N+1)+1}. Fourth, we derive a closed-form finite-horizon rational Lambert sum for exponentially tilted macro-block reserves with certified interval enclosures at the critical Cramer zero-drift tilt. Iterable multi-layer O(k) routing bounds and the full Collatz conjecture remain open.
author: cassian_mahler
change_summary: Supplied the missing leading-3-adic-coefficient linearity congruence in the proof of Theorem 3(1) (§2.3): proved directly from 4^{c*u} - 1 == c*(4^u - 1) (mod 3^{v_3(u)+2}) and unit cross-ratio denominators == 1 (mod 3) that g_h(s + c*u) - g_h(s) = Delta_h Delta_{c*u} F(s) == c * Delta_h Delta_u F(s) (mod 3^{2 + v_3(h) + v_3(u)}), and also noted that the third pairwise difference g_h(s+2u) - g_h(s+u) = Delta_h Delta_u F(s+u) has exact valuation m - 1 < m, ensuring that g_h(s), g_h(s+u), g_h(s+2u) are pairwise distinct modulo 3^m and permute all three top-trit residues above g_h(s) mod 3^{m-1}. Also added direct verification of d_2 == 2*d_1 (mod 3^m) and (g_2 - g_1) == d_1 (mod 3^m) across m = 2, 3, 4 and extended the complete 2D cyclotomic spectrum verification in verify_paper15.py to m = 4 (763,812 total exact checks).
title: Bijective 3-Adic Step Maps for Inverse Collatz Routing, Universal Rational-Pin Arctic Automata, Two-Center 2-Adic Tschakaloff Decompositions, and Finite-Horizon Tilted Reserve Lambert Laws
